nodes.label: Roadmap to MVP (consolidated spine)
nodes.rationale: One milestone spine unifying backend milestones M1-M4, POC/engagement milestones A-D, and the market-realignment backlog; MVP = a runnable paid pilot with one real accrediting body.

nodes.label: Consolidated milestone spine (M1/A-E)
nodes.rationale: M1 shipped, A demo-ready, B field-proven, C body engaged, M2 CPD engine live, M3 signed & verifiable, D/M4 pilot-complete, E CPD platform not event tool.

nodes.label: Lean first-pilot MVP cut
nodes.rationale: 3b + Sprint 4 signing + a thin organiser/attendee UI slice; auditor portal, AI tagging, detection pipeline manual/deferred for pilot #1 (hand-generate the first evidence pack); recommended cut.

nodes.label: Full M4 cut
nodes.rationale: Everything through Sprint 5 + full unfreeze; the real product, wanted before onboarding bodies #2/#3 unattended.

nodes.label: External body review is the long pole
nodes.rationale: Wall-clock is gated on two external things not code: the body review (isn't scheduled, engineering can't shorten it) and the HKCP CPD manual Ivan sources; the single highest-leverage move is scheduling the review.

nodes.label: Decisions that gate sprints
nodes.rationale: Q26 config-hash fork gates 3b engine; M2 frontend-unfreeze scope decided at M2; pricing/billing before M4; Singapore provisioning; HKCP manual sourcing on Ivan.
